from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted characteristics of a single judicial document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as stated")
    task_categories: list[str] = Field(description="The legal categories from the task list that this document belongs to")
    case_description: str | None = Field(description="A short description of the legal nature and subject matter of the case")
    key_evidence: str | None = Field(description="A brief excerpt from the text supporting the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parsed output for a single document."""
    cases: list[CaseRecord]
